competencies.title: Electrical circuit mathematics
competencies.description: Use arithmetic and algebra to reason about voltage, current, and resistance in basic circuit models.

competencies.title: Electrical power calculations
competencies.description: Calculate power from stated electrical quantities and interpret the units used in equipment information.

competencies.title: Series and parallel circuit relationships
competencies.description: Reason about equivalent resistance and branch behavior in simple, de-energized circuit models.

competencies.title: Electrical unit conversion
competencies.description: Convert common prefixes and units accurately when reading specifications or recording measurements.

competencies.title: Schematic interpretation
competencies.description: Read simple circuit descriptions and diagrams to identify components, connections, and expected logical states.

competencies.title: Electrical safety concepts
competencies.description: Recognize hazard controls, protective-equipment concepts, and the need for codes, qualified supervision, and verified de-energization.
